text.p: Vista 2000 Inc, which was delisted last May for not filing its 1995 annual report due to improprieties in earlier financial statements, said on Thursday that it has filed its 1995 report.
The report contained revised financial statements with an unqualified opinion of the Company's Independent Auditor, Grant Thornton LLP (Grant Thornton).
Vista 2000 said in June 1996 that its auditors were unable to express an opinion on the financial statements, because evidence supporting its operating results at some subsidiaries was not available.

Vista 2000 said Grant Thornton subsequently was able to perform additional auditing procedures and the company identified corrections to its financial statements primarily related to its Family Safety Products Inc.

These corrections increased the company's loss for the year ended December 30, 1995, from a loss of $12,858,000 or $2.04 per share, as previously reported in the Form 8-K, to a loss of $14,663,000, or $2.33 per share.
The company also field quarterly results for the periods ended March 30, 1996, June 29, 1996 and September 28, 1996.
